qe: What specific terminology defines the electromagnetic radiation region whose discrete energy quantum (~11 eV) is mathematically suited to dissociate a stable carbon monoxide molecule?
qh: कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड के अणु को विघटित करने के लिए आवश्यक ~11 eV ऊर्जा वाली विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग किस क्षेत्र (region) के अंतर्गत आती है?
o: The low-frequency visible spectrum loop
The thermal molecular infrared region
The high-energy ultraviolet region (पराबैंगनी क्षेत्र / Ultraviolet region)
The long-wavelength microwave domain
e: Explanation: Using Plancks quantum relation $E = h\nu$, an energy of $11\text{ eV}$ converts to a precise frequency parameter of approximately $2.65 \times 10^{15}\text{ Hz}$. This specific frequency falls directly within the boundaries of the ultraviolet region of the electromagnetic spectrum.

qe: When a linearly polarized electromagnetic wave reflects normally off a dense, optically inactive perfectly reflecting wall, what fundamental phase modification alters the resulting reflected wave expression?
qh: जब एक रैखिक ध्रुवीकृत विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग एक आदर्श परावर्तक दीवार से टकराकर परावर्तित होती है, तो उसके समीकरण में कौन सा चरण (phase) परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The directional wave configuration alters its basic frequency parameters to infinity
The mathematical phase advances by exactly $\pi$ radians ($180^\circ$), causing a directional sign reversal across its spatial field vector ($\pi$ रेडियन या $180^\circ$ का कला परिवर्तन)
The wave converts smoothly into an unbranched non-ionic surfactant lattice
The electric field vector realigns symmetrically to reach absolute zero velocity indices
e: Explanation: Reflection from an optically denser boundary introduces a phase shift of $\pi$ radians ($180^\circ$). For an incident wave $E = \hat{i}E_0 \cos(kz - wt)$, this inversion yields a reflected expression of $E_r = \hat{i}E_0 \cos(kz + wt)$ due to the simultaneous reversal of spatial propagation direction and phase boundaries.

qe: What is the physical relationship between the total energy ($U$) completely absorbed by a non-reflecting surface and the total momentum ($p$) delivered by an incident electromagnetic wave in a vacuum?
qh: एक गैर-परावर्तक सतह द्वारा पूरी तरह से अवशोषित की गई कुल ऊर्जा ($U$) और आपतित विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग द्वारा दिए गए कुल संवेग ($p$) के बीच क्या संबंध होता है?
o: $p = U \cdot c^2$ matrix layout
$p = \frac{U}{c}$ (संवेग और ऊर्जा का संबंध)
$p = \sqrt{U \cdot e_0}$ configuration
$p = nF \cdot U$ translation check
e: Explanation: Maxwells electromagnetic theory dictates that when a wave traveling in a vacuum is completely absorbed by a target surface, the momentum delivered ($p$) scales directly as the ratio of the total absorbed energy ($U$) to the speed of light ($c$), expressed as $p = \frac{U}{c}$.

qe: How does the peak electric field intensity ($E$) produced by a localized radiation point source scale relative to the average power output ($P$) of the emitting source at a constant distance?
qh: एक निश्चित दूरी पर, विकिरण बिंदु स्रोत द्वारा निर्मित चरम विद्युत क्षेत्र की तीव्रता ($E$) उत्सर्जक स्रोत की औसत शक्ति ($P$) से किस प्रकार संबंधित होती है?
o: The intensity tracks inversely with the square root of source power
The peak electric field magnitude is directly proportional to the square root of the average source power ($E \propto \sqrt{P}$) (विद्युत क्षेत्र की तीव्रता शक्ति के वर्गमूल के समानुपाती होना)
The magnitude changes properties dynamically based on cross-linked polymer network indices
The field parameters collapse to absolute zero when the source operates under high pressure
e: Explanation: The average intensity of electromagnetic radiation scales linearly with power ($I = \frac{P}{A}$). Since the intensity is mathematically linked to the square of the peak electric field intensity ($I \propto E^2$), the electric field relates directly to the square root of power ($E \propto \sqrt{P}$).

qe: What vector calculation correctly determines the spatial direction of propagation for an electromagnetic plane wave from its electric field vector $\vec{E}$ and magnetic field vector $\vec{B}$?
qh: विद्युत क्षेत्र वेक्टर $\vec{E}$ और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र वेक्टर $\vec{B}$ से एक विद्युत चुंबकीय समतल तरंग के संचरण (propagation) की दिशा का सही निर्धारण कैसे किया जाता है?
o: Along the separate standalone vector line of $\vec{E}$ or $\vec{B}$ exclusively
In the precise direction determined by the vector cross product $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$ ($\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$ की दिशा में)
Along the reverse inverse coordinate orientation of $\vec{B} \times \vec{E}$
Balanced completely across a dynamic non-conducting quaternary framework matrix
e: Explanation: Electromagnetic waves are transverse. The spatial direction of wave energy propagation is always orthogonal to both the oscillating electric field vector $\vec{E}$ and the magnetic field vector $\vec{B}$, running specifically along the cross product vector direction of $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$.

qe: What precise ratio represents the respective energy contributions made by the oscillating electric field component and the magnetic field component to the net intensity of an electromagnetic wave traveling in a vacuum?
qh: एक विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग की कुल तीव्रता में दोलन करने वाले विद्युत क्षेत्र और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के घटकों के ऊर्जा योगदान का सही अनुपात क्या होता है?
o: The ratio tracks directly as $c : 1$ based on light velocity constants
An exact equal sharing displaying a strict 1:1 contribution ratio ($1 : 1$ का समान ऊर्जा अनुपात)
A highly biased scale locked at $c^2 : 1$ across structural fields
Zero net functional parameter sharing across the tracking layout
e: Explanation: Although the field magnitudes differ ($E_0 = c \cdot B_0$), the average energy densities stored within the electric field ($U_E = \frac{1}{4}\varepsilon_0 E_0^2$) and the magnetic field ($U_B = \frac{1}{4\mu_0} B_0^2$) are mathematically identical, yielding a strict energy distribution ratio of 1:1.

qe: How does the peak amplitude of the radiating electric field vector ($E_0$) generated by a classic dipole antenna decay relative to the distance ($r$) measured from the source repository?
qh: एक क्लासिक द्विध्रुव एंटीना (dipole antenna) द्वारा उत्पन्न विकिरण विद्युत क्षेत्र वेक्टर के चरम आयाम ($E_0$) का मान स्रोत से दूरी ($r$) के साथ किस प्रकार घटता है?
o: It decays exponentially matching a cubic inverse scale $\frac{1}{r^3}$
It falls off inversely as the simple linear distance parameter ($E_0 \propto \frac{1}{r}$) (दूरी के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होना)
It follows a strict inverse-square geometric trajectory matching $\frac{1}{r^2}$
The value remains completely constant ignoring spatial coordinate shifts
e: Explanation: For radiation fields far from a dipole antenna, the wave intensity decays according to an inverse-square law ($I \propto \frac{1}{r^2}$). Since the intensity scales with the square of the field amplitude ($I \propto E_0^2$), the electric field amplitude decreases as $\frac{1}{r}$.

qe: What polarization status describes a standard plane electromagnetic wave whose electric field vector tracks linearly along a single spatial axis perpendicular to the direction of propagation?
qh: उस विद्युत चुंबकीय समतल तरंग को क्या कहा जाता है जिसका विद्युत क्षेत्र वेक्टर संचरण की दिशा के लंबवत एक ही रैखिक अक्ष पर दोलन करता है?
o: Circularly polarized configuration loop
Plane Polarized / Linearly Polarized (समतल ध्रुवीकृत / Plane Polarized)
Amorphous unaligned non-polar resin layer
Quaternary coordinate cross-linked lattice setup
e: Explanation: If the electric field oscillations of an electromagnetic wave are strictly restricted to a single linear direction within a plane perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation, the wave is standardly designated as plane polarized.

qe: If a plane electromagnetic wave propagates specifically along the positive x-direction, which spatial axis pairs are legally permitted to contain the oscillating vectors of $\vec{E}$ and $\vec{B}$?
qh: यदि एक समतल विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग विशेष रूप से धनात्मक x-दिशा में संचरित होती है, तो $\vec{E}$ और $\vec{B}$ के दोलन किन अक्षों (axes) पर हो सकते हैं?
o: The longitudinal vectors $E_x$ and $B_x$ exclusively along the path
Any orthogonal combination confined strictly within the y-axis and z-axis parameters ($E_y, B_z$ या $E_z, B_y$) (y और z अक्षों के विन्यास में होना)
The cross-linked coordinates using linear unbranched caprolactam lines
The absolute zero potential slots tracking along the collection well boundaries
e: Explanation: Because electromagnetic waves are transverse, the oscillating field vectors $\vec{E}$ and $\vec{B}$ must be perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation. If the wave travels along the x-axis, the fields must reside on the y and z axes, while maintaining mutual perpendicularity.

qe: What core parameter dictates the baseline oscillation frequency of the electromagnetic waves emitted into space by an oscillating or accelerating charged particle?
qh: एक दोलन करने वाले या त्वरित आवेशित कण द्वारा अंतरिक्ष में उत्सर्जित विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगों की आवृत्ति (frequency) मुख्य रूप से किस पर निर्भर करती है?
o: The total structural surface area of the emitting antenna tower
The exact internal frequency with which the charged particle vibrates about its equilibrium position (आवेशित कण के दोलन की अपनी आवृत्ति के बराबर होना)
The conversion velocity of adjacent sugars into volatile aliphatic amides
The non-conducting protective surround framework index running across layers
e: Explanation: An accelerating or oscillating charge acts as the physical source of electromagnetic radiation. The frequency of the resulting emitted electromagnetic wave is directly determined by, and equal to, the structural frequency of the particle's mechanical oscillation.

qe: Which physical operational status must a localized electric charge assume to function as an active, ongoing source capable of generating electromagnetic waves?
qh: एक विद्युत आवेश को विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें उत्पन्न करने के लिए किस विशिष्ट भौतिक स्थिति (physical status) में होना अनिवार्य है?
o: Remaining completely at rest inside a secure electrostatic zone
Moving in a state of acceleration, such as executing circular orbits or oscillating harmonic motions (त्वरित या दोलन गति में होना)
Sustaining an unbranched linear velocity vector under zero pressure fields
Dissolving into an amorphous cross-linked network layer
e: Explanation: Stationary charges produce only static electric fields, and charges moving at a constant velocity generate static magnetic fields without radiating energy. Electromagnetic waves are produced exclusively by accelerating or oscillating electric charges.

qe: What precise mathematical allocation calculates the radiation pressure ($p$) exerted on a perfectly absorbing surface placed normally in a vacuum under an incident wave intensity ($I$)?
qh: निर्वात में रखे एक पूर्ण अवशोषक (perfectly absorbing) सतह पर आपतित तरंग तीव्रता ($I$) द्वारा लगाया गया विकिरण दबाव ($p$) क्या होता है?
o: $p = I \cdot c$ velocity expansion product
$p = \frac{I}{c}$ (पूर्ण अवशोषण के लिए विकिरण दबाव सूत्र)
$p = \frac{2I}{c}$ extensive reflection potential
$p = \frac{I}{c^2}$ monomeric addition ring index
e: Explanation: Radiation pressure matches momentum transfer per unit area per unit time. For a completely non-reflecting surface that undergoes absolute, total absorption of the incident wave, the radiation pressure is calculated as $p = \frac{I}{c}$.

qe: What calculated value defines the radiation pressure ($p$) experienced by a target boundary surface undergoing total, complete reflection of an incident electromagnetic wave?
qh: एक सतह जो आपतित विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग का पूर्ण परावर्तन (total reflection) करती है, उसके द्वारा अनुभव किया जाने वाला विकिरण दबाव ($p$) क्या होता है?
o: $p = \frac{I}{c}$ baseline absorption threshold
$p = \frac{2I}{c}$ (पूर्ण परावर्तन के लिए विकिरण दबाव सूत्र)
$p = I \cdot c$ cross-linked resin indicator
$p = zero$ neutral tracking alignment value
e: Explanation: When an electromagnetic wave is completely reflected by a mirror-like surface, the change in momentum is doubled because the wave bounces back with an equal and opposite momentum vector, resulting in a radiation pressure of $p = \frac{2I}{c}$.

qe: Why is the precise spatial orientation of a portable radio tracking loop highly critical relative to the location of a broadcasting station during transmission tuning?
qh: सिग्नल ट्यूनिंग के दौरान एक पोर्टेबल रेडियो एंटीना का प्रसारण स्टेशन (broadcasting station) के सापेक्ष अभिविन्यास (orientation) अत्यधिक महत्वपूर्ण क्यों होता है?
o: Because radio waves turn completely volatile if unaligned with local gravity fields

Because the transmitted electromagnetic waves are plane-polarized, requiring the receiving antenna wire to align parallel to the wave's electric field vibrations (विद्युत क्षेत्र के कंपन के समानांतर एंटीना का संरेखण होना)
Because the antenna requires direct contact with unbranched synthetic polyamides across soil
Because any spatial deviation drops the ionizable sugar-phosphate backbone lines to zero
e: Explanation: Broadcast radio waves are plane-polarized. For maximum energy capture and clear signal induction via resonance, the receiving antenna rod or loop must be aligned parallel to the specific vibration plane of the incoming wave's electric field vector.

qe: What underlying physical concept explains why a microwave oven can heat up food items containing water molecules with exceptional thermal efficiency?
qh: माइक्रोवेव ओवन पानी के अणुओं वाले खाद्य पदार्थों को अत्यधिक तापीय दक्षता के साथ क्यों गर्म कर पाता है, इसका मुख्य भौतिक कारण क्या है?
o: Microwaves induce a fast free-radical addition cross-linking across carbohydrates

The operational frequency of the microwaves matches the natural resonant rotational frequency of polar water molecules, triggering intense dielectric heating (जल अणुओं की घूर्णन आवृत्ति के साथ अनुनाद होना)
The radiation converts internal biological sugars into volatile open-chain gases
The waves eliminate the current carrying capacity of internal mineral ions permanently
e: Explanation: Microwave ovens operate on the principle of dielectric heating. The frequency of the emitted microwaves ($\sim 2.45\text{ GHz}$) matches the natural resonant rotational frequency of polar water molecules ($H_2O$) inside the food, causing them to rotate rapidly and generate heat through molecular friction.

qe: What formal term defines the time-varying current component that flows through the dielectric spacing of a capacitor when the electric flux across the plates is changing over time?
qh: जब एक कैपेसिटर की प्लेटों के बीच विद्युत प्रवाह (electric flux) समय के साथ बदलता है, तो उसके ढांकता हुआ स्थान (dielectric spacing) में प्रवाहित होने वाले विद्युत प्रवाह घटक को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Standard metallic conduction loop current
Displacement Current ($I_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{d\Phi_E}{dt}$) (विस्थापन धारा / Displacement Current)
Amorphous Novolac network line flow
Thermosetting cross-linked coordination node current
e: Explanation: Introduced by Maxwell to satisfy the continuity equation, displacement current ($I_d$) is a current component that arises in regions experiencing time-varying electric fields or changing electric flux ($\Phi_E$), mathematically expressed as $I_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{d\Phi_E}{dt}$.

qe: If a variable-frequency AC source driving a capacitor circuit undergoes a systematic decrease in its operational frequency, how will the internal displacement current respond?
qh: यदि एक कैपेसिटर सर्किट को चलाने वाले AC स्रोत की आवृत्ति (frequency) कम हो जाती है, तो विस्थापन धारा पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
o: The displacement current increases exponentially via free-radical expansion loops

The displacement current decreases because lower frequency elevates capacitive reactance, choking conduction and displacement current equally ($X_c \propto \frac{1}{f}$) (आवृत्ति घटने से विस्थापन धारा का मान कम होना)
The signal transforms instantly into a highly volatile non-polar gas phase
The current spikes to absolute infinity due to structural resonance with caprolactam links
e: Explanation: Capacitive reactance tracks inversely with frequency ($X_c = \frac{1}{2\pi f C}$). Decreasing the AC source frequency increases the reactance, which reduces the conduction current in the circuit wire. Since the displacement current ($I_d$) across the capacitor plates always matches the conduction current ($I_c$), it decreases accordingly.

qe: What vector parameter, defined mathematically as $\vec{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$, expresses both the energy flux density and direction of propagation of an electromagnetic wave?
qh: विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग के ऊर्जा प्रवाह घनत्व और संचरण की दिशा को व्यक्त करने वाले वेक्टर $\vec{S} = \frac{1}{\mu_0} (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$ को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: The Faraday electrodeposition trajectory guide
The Poynting Vector (पॉइंटिंग वेक्टर / Poynting Vector)
The linear unbranched Novolac calculation line
The continuous free-radical addition polymer initiator line
e: Explanation: The Poynting vector ($\vec{S}$) represents the directional energy flux density (power per unit area) of an electromagnetic wave. Its magnitude equals the wave intensity, and its directional vector points along the cross product direction of $\vec{E} \times \vec{B}$.

qe: What physical mechanical phenomenon allows a highly focused, intense laser beam to suspend a tiny, light ball freely inside a transparent vacuum chamber?
qh: किस भौतिक यांत्रिक घटना के कारण एक अत्यधिक केंद्रित, तीव्र लेजर बीम एक पारदर्शी निर्वात कक्ष के भीतर एक छोटी, हल्की गेंद को स्वतंत्र रूप से हवा में लटका सकती है?
o: The continuous free-radical polymerization of the ball's outer coating
The radiation pressure exerted by the laser beam due to momentum transfer, counteracting the gravitational force (तरंगों द्वारा लगाया गया विकिरण दबाव / radiation pressure)
The spontaneous conversion of adjacent residual air into an unbranched starch gel
The creation of permanent high-voltage electrode potential drop lines around the body
e: Explanation: Electromagnetic waves carry momentum ($p = \frac{U}{c}$). When a laser beam strikes an object, this momentum is transferred, exerting a measurable force per unit area known as radiation pressure. If focused properly, this upward radiation pressure can balance gravity to levitate a small mass.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct the synthetic rubber elastomer known as Neoprene?
qh: सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमर नियोप्रीन (Neoprene) जैसे सिंथेटिक रबर का निर्माण करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene)
Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) (क्लोरोप्रीन मोनोमर)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Neoprene is a durable synthetic rubber produced by the linear addition polymerization of chloroprene monomers, chemically designated as 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What unique conformational property provides long-term kinetic stability to colloidal dispersions, preventing single particles from colliding and precipitating?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा संरचनात्मक पैरामीटर कोलाइडल फैलाव (colloidal dispersions) को दीर्घकालिक गतिज स्थिरता प्रदान करता है, एकल कणों को आपस में टकराने और अवक्षेपित होने से रोकता है?
o: The random helix coiling of unbranched polyolefin branches
The presence of equal and similar electrical charges on all dispersed colloidal particles, causing mutual electrostatic repulsion (कणों पर समान विद्युत आवेश के कारण प्रतिकर्षण)
The complete conversion of all surface functional groups into volatile non-ionic ethers
The total presence of short-chain aromatic links that absorb moisture
e: Explanation: Colloidal particles carry a net electrical charge of the same sign. The resulting mutual electrostatic repulsion prevents the particles from aggregating into larger clusters when they collide, stabilizing the colloidal dispersion.

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.

qe: What is the correct mathematical expression used to calculate the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte from its molar conductivity values?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोलाइट मानों से कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के विघटन की डिग्री ($\alpha$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $\alpha = \Lambda_m \cdot \Lambda_m^\circ$
$\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$ (विघटन की डिग्री सूत्र)
$\alpha = \frac{\alpha \cdot 1000}{M}$
$\alpha = nF E^\circ_{cell}$
e: Explanation: The degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte at a specific concentration is calculated as the ratio of its molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) to its limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$): $\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$.

qe: What is the core mathematical formula used to calculate the Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of a solution from its specific conductivity ($\kappa$) and molarity ($M$) in standard laboratory units?
qh: मानक प्रयोगशाला इकाइयों में समाधान की विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) और मोलरिटी ($M$) से उसकी मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\Lambda_m = \frac{M \cdot \kappa}{1000}$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$ (मोलर चालकता सूत्र)
$\Lambda_m = \kappa \cdot G^*$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \cdot R}{M}$
e: Explanation: When conductivity $\kappa$ is measured in $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ and concentration $M$ is in $\text{mol/L}$, the molar conductivity is calculated using the formula: $\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$.

qe: Which specific organic compound is generated when a molecule of natural cane sugar (sucrose) undergoes acidic hydrolysis?
qh: जब प्राकृतिक गन्ने की चीनी (सुक्रोज) का एक अणु अम्लीय जलअपघटन से गुजरता है तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Two identical units of D-galactose
An equimolar mixture of D-glucose and D-fructose (ग्लूकोज एवं फ्रुक्टोज मिश्रण)
Two units of highly branched amylopectin
One molecule of glycine and one molecule of aminocaproic acid
e: Explanation: Hydrolyzing the disaccharide sucrose breaks its internal glycosidic linkage, releasing an equimolar mixture of one D-glucose molecule and one D-fructose molecule.

qe: What happens to the structure of the cyclic monomer caprolactam when it is heated with water to generate Nylon-6?
qh: जब चक्रीय मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम को नायलॉन-6 उत्पन्न करने के लिए पानी के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into a three-dimensional thermosetting network containing methylene bridges
It undergoes hydrolytic ring-opening cleavage to yield an open amino acid chain that polymerizes into a polyamide (रिंग-ओपनिंग जलअपघटन)
It undergoes oxidation into a dibasic dicarboxylic acid fragment
It forms insoluble precipitates via the common-ion effect
e: Explanation: Heating caprolactam with water at elevated temperatures breaks its internal cyclic amide bond. This ring-opening hydrolytic step yields $\varepsilon$-aminocaproic acid, which polymerizes into the linear polyamide chain of Nylon-6.

qe: What specific operational role does benzoyl peroxide assume when added to an alkene mixture during free-radical addition polymerization?
qh: मुक्त-कण जोड़ पॉलीमराइजेशन के दौरान एल्कीन मिश्रण में मिलाए जाने पर बेंज़ोयल पेरोक्साइड क्या विशिष्ट परिचालन भूमिका निभाता है?
o: It acts as a mechanical filler to increase the total density of the plastic block
It serves as a reaction initiator by undergoing homolytic cleavage to generate active free radicals (मुक्त मूलक आरंभक)
It functions as a chemical chemical inhibitor that immediately stops chain propagation
It clarifies the basification parameters of the solution via acid-base buffer mechanisms
e: Explanation: Benzoyl peroxide is thermally unstable and easily undergoes homolytic cleavage at its oxygen-oxygen single bond ($-O-O-$). This dissociation generates active phenyl free radicals that attack alkene monomers to initiate free-radical chain-growth polymerization.

qe: Which specific organic functional group is generated when the carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of an adjacent unit to build a protein?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह तब उत्पन्न होता है जब एक अमीनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिल समूह प्रोटीन बनाने के लिए आसन्न इकाई के अमीनो समूह के साथ संघनित होता है?
o: Glycosidic connection bridging rings together
Peptide linkage / Amide bond (पेप्टाइड बंध / एमाइड लिंक)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge balancing frames
Sulfur disulfide cross-link system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Combining the alpha-carboxyl group of one amino acid with the alpha-amino center of another eliminates a water molecule, establishing a covalent amide linkage ($-CONH-$) termed a peptide bond or peptide linkage.

qe: What happens to the structure of linear Novolac strands if they are mixed with excess formaldehyde gas and subjected to high thermal curing?
qh: यदि रैखिक नोवोलेक स्ट्रैंड्स को अतिरिक्त फॉर्मलाडेहाइड(?) गैस के साथ मिला जाए और उच्च थर्मल क्यूरिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उनकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: They break down into volatile liquid phenols via hydrolytic cleavage
They develop extensive covalent methylene cross-links, transforming the linear resin into the rigid thermosetting network Bakelite (क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बैकेलाइट नेटवर्क)
They convert into an unbranched biodegradable polyester chain configuration
They form an explicit water-soluble uncharged non-ionic surfactant lattice balanced by sodium
e: Explanation: Novolac is a linear condensation intermediate. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene linkages that cross-link the chains into a permanent three-dimensional network, creating the infusible thermosetting polymer Bakelite.

qe: What structural unit remains after a nucleotide monomer loses its terminal esterified phosphate group?
qh: एक न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर जब अपने एस्टरीकृत फॉस्फेट समूह को खो देता है, तो कौन सी संरचनात्मक इकाई शेष बचती है?
o: A volatile aliphatic open-chain non-polar gas matrix
Nucleoside (न्यूक्लिओसाइड)
An active free-radical addition polymer initiator
A cross-linked three-dimensional network panel
e: Explanation: A nucleoside contains only a pentose sugar linked to a nitrogenous base. Adding a phosphate group to its 5'-position transforms it into a full nucleotide.

qe: Which strong covalent linkage connects consecutive nucleotide monomers together along a single-stranded DNA or RNA polymer chain?
qh: कौन सा मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध डीएनए या आरएनए के एक एकल धागे (single strand) के साथ लगातार न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: N-glycosidic link bridging rings together
3'-5' phosphodiester linkage (3'-5' फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध)
Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond
Sulfur disulfide cross-link bridge system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Nucleotides polymerize into nucleic acid chains via 3'-5' phosphodiester linkages, where a phosphate group forms stable ester covalent bonds between the 3'-hydroxyl group of one sugar ring and the 5'-hydroxyl group of the next.

qe: What molecular architectural arrangement details the relative directionality of the two complementary strands inside a DNA double helix model?
qh: कौन सा आणविक संरचनात्मक विन्यास डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल के भीतर दो पूरक धागों की सापेक्ष दिशात्मकता (relative directionality) का विवरण देता है?
o: They run parallel in the exact same 5' to 3' spatial direction
They exhibit anti-parallel polarity, where one strand runs 5' to 3' and the other runs 3' to 5' (प्रति-समानांतर ध्रुवता / anti-parallel)
They are arranged as separate open-chain unlinked carbohydrate blocks
They cross-link randomly into a single infusible thermosetting net plastic
e: Explanation: The twin strands of a DNA double helix run anti-parallel to one another. One strand is oriented in the 5' to 3' direction, while its complementary counter-strand features a reverse 3' to 5' alignment.

qe: What architectural feature characterises the alpha-helix secondary structure of a protein, keeping the right-handed screw shape stable?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक प्रोटीन की अल्फा-हेलिक्स माध्यमिक संरचना की विशेषता है, जो दाहिने हाथ की पेंच जैसी आकृति को स्थिर रखती है?
o: Weak van der Waals forces acting uniformly across non-polar branches
Intramolecular hydrogen bonds formed between the N-H group of an amino acid residue and the carbonyl C=O group of an adjacent turn (N-H और C=O के बीच हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid reduction with basic catalysts
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide cross-linked coordination zones
e: Explanation: The helical conformation of an $\alpha$-helix is locked and stabilized by a dense network of regular hydrogen bonds. These form between the polar amide $N-H$ groups situated along one loop of the coiling backbone and the carbonyl $C=O$ functional groups of the adjacent turn.

qe: What descriptive terminology defines the unique architectural feature of the genetic code known as 'degeneracy'?
qh: 'अपभ्रष्टता' (degeneracy) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले आनुवंशिक कोड की अनूठी संरचनात्मक विशेषता को क्या शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है?
o: A single codon can simultaneously code for multiple different amino acids
A single amino acid can be specified and coded by more than one distinct codon (एक से अधिक कोडन द्वारा एक अमीनो अम्ल का कोडिंग)
The codons turn completely volatile and drop down to zero value metrics
The genetic dictionary changes properties dynamically based on solution pressure
e: Explanation: The genetic code is redundant or degenerate. Because there are 61 amino-acid-specifying codons but only 20 standard amino acids, many amino acids are specified by more than one distinct codon (e.g., phenylalanine is targeted by both UUU and UUC).

qe: Which specific initiation codon serves the dual role of initiating translation while coding for the amino acid methionine?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट दीक्षा कोडन (initiation codon) अमीनो एसिड मेथिओनिन के लिए कोडिंग करते हुए अनुवाद शुरू करने की दोहरी भूमिका निभाता है?
o: UUU phenylalanine code
AUG codon (AUG कोडन)
UAA ochre terminator factor
UGA opel stop marker segment
e: Explanation: The triplet codon AUG plays a dual role in molecular genetics: it codes for the essential amino acid methionine and serves as the universal initiation marker that establishes the reading frame for ribosomes.

qe: Which functional pairing correctly lists the classic nonsense or 'stop' codons that terminate polypeptide chain synthesis?
qh: कौन सा कार्यात्मक युग्म क्लासिक नॉनसेंस या 'स्टॉप' कोडन (stop codons) को सही ढंग से सूचीबद्ध करता है जो पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला संश्लेषण को समाप्त करते हैं?
o: AUG, GUG, and UUU initiation entries
UAA, UAG, and UGA (UAA, UAG एवं UGA स्टॉप कोडन)
GAA, GAG, and GUG alternative blocks
CCA, CCC, and CCG structural segments
e: Explanation: Three codons do not code for any amino acid residues. Named nonsense or stop codons, the triplet arrangements UAA (ochre), UAG (amber), and UGA (opal) signal release factors to terminate translation.

qe: What name is assigned to the regions of an area that are situated before the start codon and after the stop codon, which are essential for translation efficiency?
qh: एक area के उन क्षेत्रों को क्या नाम दिया गया है जो स्टार्ट कोडन से पहले और स्टॉप कोडन के बाद स्थित होते हैं, जो अनुवाद दक्षता के लिए आवश्यक हैं?
o: Exon coding domains
Untranslated Regions / UTRs (अननुवादित क्षेत्र / UTRs)
Cistronic overlapping fields
Polyamide structural link sets
e: Explanation: Messenger RNA molecules contain sequences flanking the coding frame: located before the start codon at the 5'-end and after the stop codon at the 3'-end, these non-translated segments are designated as Untranslated Regions (UTRs) and are vital for translation efficiency.

qe: What direct physical consequence characterizes a point mutation, differentiating it from an extensive frame-shift mutation?
qh: कौन सा प्रत्यक्ष भौतिक परिणाम एक बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन (point mutation) की विशेषता है, जो इसे व्यापक फ्रेम-शिफ्ट उत्परिवर्तन से अलग करता है?
o: The entire macromolecule cross-links into an insoluble solid net layer
A change involving the substitution of a single base pair inside the DNA sequence (एकल क्षारक युग्म में परिवर्तन)
The automatic loss of all nitrogen bases across the targeted cistron
The sudden volatilization of the sugar phosphate framework profile
e: Explanation: A point mutation is a genetic change that involves the substitution of a single nucleotide base pair within a DNA sequence, as seen in sickle-cell anemia, distinct from multi-base insertions or deletions that disrupt the reading frame.

qe: What structural nomenclature describes a stable chemical arrangement where a single central transition metal ion is coordinated to surrounding ligand molecules via coordinate covalent bonds?
qh: उस स्थिर रासायनिक व्यवस्था को क्या कहा जाता है जहां एक केंद्रीय संक्रमण धातु आयन उपसहसंयोजक बंधों (coordinate covalent bonds) के माध्यम से आसपास के लिगैंड अणुओं से जुड़ा होता है?
o: Amorphous Novolac resin fractions
Coordination Compound / Complex (उपसहसंयोजक यौगिक / कॉम्प्लेक्स)
Linear tactical unbranched polyolefin lines
Zwitterionic single base pair configurations
e: Explanation: A coordination compound consists of a central metal atom or ion (typically a transition element) bonded via coordinate covalent links to a surrounding array of electron-donating molecules or ions termed ligands.

qe: What total extended linear dimension characterizes the circular genomic DNA payload packed inside a single cell of *Escherichia coli*?
qh: *Escherichia coli* की एक एकल कोशिका के भीतर पैक किए गए गोलाकार जीनोमिक डीएनए पेलोड की कुल विस्तारित रैखिक लंबाई क्या है?
o: 2.2 meters absolute length profile
Approximately 1.36 millimeters (लगभग 1.36 मिलीमीटर)
34 centimeters calculated index
5386 nanometers unbranched grid
e: Explanation: Multiplying the *E. coli* genome size ($4.6 \times 10^6\text{ base pairs}$) by the inter-pair spacing interval ($0.34 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$) shows that its circular chromosome has an extended linear length of approximately 1.36 millimeters.
